name: VartaFlow for WooCommerce
author: nishantsingh06

sections.description:
VartaFlow helps WooCommerce stores automate customer communication on WhatsApp using the official WhatsApp Business Platform.

The VartaFlow WooCommerce plugin enables merchants to recover abandoned carts, automate order updates, verify Cash on Delivery orders, and engage customers through WhatsApp.

Automate WhatsApp Notifications For

  • Abandoned cart recovery
  • Cash on Delivery (CoD) order confirmation
  • Order confirmation notifications
  • Shipment notifications
  • Out-for-delivery updates
  • Delivery confirmations
  • Order cancellation notifications
  • Custom WooCommerce status notifications

WooCommerce Integration Features

  • One-click VartaFlow account connection
  • Sync WooCommerce order events with VartaFlow
  • Support for official WhatsApp Business API
  • Automated customer notifications
  • Event tracking for customer segmentation
  • Support for WooCommerce HPOS
  • Easy setup and configuration

Additional VartaFlow Features

Using your connected VartaFlow account, you can also:

  • Send bulk WhatsApp campaigns
  • Create WhatsApp automation flows
  • Manage customer conversations from a shared inbox
  • Create and manage WhatsApp templates
  • Track campaign performance
  • Manage contacts and customer segments
  • Integrate Meta WhatsApp Business accounts

For setup instructions and documentation, visit:

https://vartaflow.com/docs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vartaflow-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → VartaFlow.
  4. Click “Connect to VartaFlow”.
  5. Log in or create your VartaFlow account.
  6. Complete WhatsApp Business account setup.
  7. Configure notification settings and activate your preferred workflows.
sections.faq:
What can this plugin do?

The plugin automatically sends WhatsApp notifications for important WooCommerce events including abandoned carts, order confirmations, CoD verification, shipment updates, and delivery notifications.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business API account?

Yes. VartaFlow uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform. You must connect a WhatsApp Business Account through Meta.

Can I use my existing WhatsApp number?

Yes, if the number is eligible for WhatsApp Business Platform onboarding and follows Meta’s requirements.

Does this plugin support Cash on Delivery verification?

Yes. Customers can receive WhatsApp messages with confirmation buttons to verify CoD orders before processing.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I send bulk WhatsApp campaigns?

Yes. Once connected to VartaFlow, you can create and send approved WhatsApp template campaigns to your customers.

Does this plugin store WhatsApp messages?

Customer conversations are managed through your VartaFlow account. The plugin only syncs WooCommerce events and customer data required for notification workflows.
